summary: A four-track groovebox firmware forked from SLOOP, pairing 303 or Juno-style, Elements and Plaits synth tracks with an LXR-02 drum synth and generators that write parts as you play.
features: Track 1 switches between a TB-303 voice and a Juno-106 style polysynth
64-step sequencer with 4-note chords, ratchets, slides, chance, song arranger
GEN writes parts on one key and progression; ACID GEN and DRUM GEN
Clouds-based granular send, reverb, delay and punch-in effects
USB audio in stereo or six-channel stems, MIDI out per track, DAW sync
Reads SLOOP projects up to 2.6 only; back up before switching firmware
